field_interpretation.calendar_date: JST civil date; no price/bar inference.
field_interpretation.cash_open: TSE cash-market scheduled open under CAL-1 plus actual Cabinet holiday dates in CAL-2.
field_interpretation.ose_holiday_trading: Confirmed OSE index-futures holiday-trading date from final-status CAL-3; false includes confirmed non-implementation exceptions.
field_interpretation.ose_trade_date: Assigned OSE day/holiday-session trade date: self on a cash-open day; next cash-open date on a confirmed holiday-trading day; null for all other cash-closed dates.  It is not a night timestamp.

revision_history.change: Holiday trading started; final list controls actual individual dates.
Cash and derivatives trading-hours change; morning C01 route unchanged but schedule version retained.

known_final_schedule_revision.result: holiday trading not conducted; replaces earlier 2023 plan for that date.

final_notice_crosschecks.status_source: Notice table, cross-checked to ose_final_holiday_list snapshot and days rows.
Notice announces the final schedule and links to the holiday-trading resource; target statuses are cross-checked to ose_final_holiday_list snapshot and days rows.
